title.zh: 农场乳品配送路线助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Reconcile packed orders, delivery receipts and container returns without mixing their units.
requirements.zh: 核对已装箱订单、配送签收及容器回收，不混淆其计量口径。

requirements.en: Record dispatch-condition readings and escalate exceptions to the release decision-maker.
requirements.zh: 记录发运条件读数，并将异常上报放行决策负责人。

requirements.en: Communicate delivery changes and support revisions to stop order.
requirements.zh: 沟通配送变更，并协助调整停靠顺序。

requirements.en: Preferred: use commercial route-optimization software for delivery planning.
requirements.zh: 优先：使用商业路线优化软件规划配送。
